name: ai-chat-server
description: Streaming chat API fronting Amazon Bedrock (Claude via Converse, Grok via Mantle)

scripts.check: for f in src/index.js src/auth.js src/config.js src/models.js src/mantleToken.js src/originGuard.js src/store.js src/providers/claude.js src/providers/grok.js src/providers/grokReasoning.js src/routes/chat.js src/routes/conversations.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
